user.title: Add TiMini Print
user.description: Connect to a TiMini Print Server add-on already installed and running on your Home Assistant host. This step only asks the add-on to scan for printers to confirm it's reachable - it does not print anything, so no paper is used during setup.

data.name: Name
data.host: Host (usually the same IP as your Home Assistant instance, since the add-on runs alongside it)

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the TiMini Print add-on. Check host/port, and that the add-on is installed, running, and its own web UI works at http://<host>:<port>/.

abort.already_configured: This TiMini Print add-on connection is already configured.
